consequence.statement: Environments that had the ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure feature gate disabled will have it permanently enabled after the upgrade, since it is no longer possible to disable it.
consequence.remediation: No operator step can keep the gate disabled; verify that the now-permanently-enabled gate behavior is acceptable.
